annotations.title: Share a graded ticket to Tail

description: Share an owned saved Grade report to Tail with nothing to type. First call with reportId returns the exact preview and previewBinding: show it to the customer. After their explicit yes, call again with confirmation PUBLISH_POST, commandKey and that previewBinding (fWarning when the preview requires it). Never places a wager. Keep the caller-generated commandKey (16-120 characters) stable for this action and all retries. Action and version are fixed by this tool; do not supply them.
name: share_graded_ticket_to_tail
